logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of ruthenium complexes was assessed using the shake-flask method combined with ICP-MS analysis. To do this, an equal volume of water was added to 2 mL of a stock solution of ruthenium complexes in octanol, followed by incubation for 24 h at 37 °C with continuous shaking. After the incubation period, the mixture was centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 10 min to separate the octanol and water phases. Then, 100 μL samples from each phase were digested in 400 μL of HNO3 and diluted to a final volume of 10 mL. The ruthenium content in each layer was determined by referencing a standard curve. The Po/w value was calculated as the ratio of the concentration in the organic phase (Co) to the concentration in the aqueous phase (Cw).
